line_items.reasoning: Q3 revenue came in at $6.8B, above the guided ~$6.7B midpoint and above the top end of the ±$300M range ($7.0B ceiling), and full-year Data Center GPU outlook was raised to >$5B vs. the prior >$4.5B guide.
Non-GAAP gross margin of 54.0% exceeded the guided ~53.5%, driven by a favorable Data Center revenue mix now exceeding 50% of total revenue.
No explicit contradictions were reported for the guided ~$1.9B non-GAAP opex, ~13% tax rate, or ~1.64B diluted share count, suggesting these came in roughly as expected.

Data Center grew strongly (+25% QoQ) and Client grew (+26% QoQ), both beating expectations, but Embedded declined 25% YoY with little recovery (vs. guided 'up sequentially'), and Gaming fell 29% QoQ — worse than the guided 'down double-digit percentage' range.
